exposure: Endoscopic foraminoplasty of the posterior fossa cyst
Ventriculo-peritoneal shunt placement in the posterior fossa
Shunt placement in the subdural space
cohort: A full-term infant presenting with complex hydrocephalus due to Dandy-Walker malformation.
finding: A staged neuroendoscopic management approach for complex hydrocephalus in a full-term infant with Dandy-Walker malformation led to symptom amelioration over 18 months, despite initial recurrences and the development of subdural hygromas.
